svg.title: LANE DEFENDER
svg.text: three lanes, automatic fire, numeric hazards — 3:4 playfield letterboxed in its slot
boss — integrity on the chest plate
barrier — counter walks up per shot

g.text: Playfield is authored at 3:4 and pillarboxed in near-black — never stretched
Boss integrity and hazard counters sit on their own plates, not on the art
Normal enemies get a hit spark only; bosses and rare drops get the spectacle
Cutouts share one cast with Endless Runner; hazards are bevelled primitives

svg.text: neutral slate frame #93a1b2 — the minigame never borrows a service window accent
